title.original: Alignment Contracts for Agentic Security Systems
title.zh: 智能体安全系统的对齐契约
title.en: Alignment Contracts for Agentic Security Systems

inclusion_reason.zh: Alignment Contracts 提供可组合的效果契约语言、可判定监视器和形式证明，可复用于高权限 Agent 的系统边界。
inclusion_reason.en: Alignment Contracts provide a composable effect language, decidable monitors, and formal guarantees reusable at the boundary of high-privilege agents.

abstract.zh: Alignment Contracts 用有限轨迹上的形式契约约束 Agent 安全工具的可观测副作用，明确作用域、资源预算、禁止效果和披露策略。
abstract.en: Alignment Contracts formally constrain observable effect traces of security agents, specifying scope, resource budgets, forbidden effects, and disclosure policy.

problem.zh: 漏洞发现 Agent 需要在授权范围内保留强攻击能力，但现有 Guardrail 未把“哪些可观测效果在何范围允许”变成可证明契约。
problem.en: Security agents need strong offensive capability inside an engagement while denying it outside scope, yet guardrails do not make allowed observable effects a provable contract.

approach.zh: 论文给出有限轨迹语义、满足与违约见证、契约细化和单向组合规则，并研究监视器可判定性与保证边界。
approach.en: The paper defines finite-trace semantics, satisfaction and finite violation witnesses, refinement and one-way composition, and decidability and guarantee boundaries for monitors.

system_design.zh: 契约语言编译为效果监视器，所有中介化工具效果进入 trace；监视器检查作用域、预算和披露约束，并保留可审计违约见证。
system_design.en: Contracts compile to effect monitors; all mediated tool effects enter a trace checked for scope, budget, and disclosure constraints with auditable violation witnesses.

key_results.zh: 形式核心证明在效果完全中介的假设下可获得执行健全性，并由 Lean 工件检查关键定理，同时明确不可判定和可观测性边界。
key_results.en: The formal core proves enforcement soundness under complete effect mediation, checks key theorems in Lean, and explicitly characterizes undecidability and observability limits.

limitations.zh: 保证依赖 Effect Observability Assumption；未中介的网络、物理或隐式效果不受约束，实例化也主要针对 Web 安全工作流。
limitations.en: Guarantees depend on the Effect Observability Assumption; unmediated network, physical, or implicit effects remain outside scope, and instantiation centers on web security.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
